# Prathima Hospitals

> > Prathima Hospitals is a multi-specialty healthcare provider with advanced facilities across Hyderabad and Telangana, offering comprehensive medical services from cardiology to organ transplantation.

Prathima Hospitals operates multiple branches in Hyderabad (Kachiguda and Kukatpally) providing 24/7 emergency care, specialized surgical procedures, and critical care services. The hospital network is part of the PRATHIMA Group and specializes in advanced treatments including organ transplantation, minimally invasive surgery, and comprehensive specialty care.
